_comment: commit is the tip of quackscience/rawduck's own 'v1.5.4' branch ("Bump DuckDB submodule and CI to v1.5.4 (Variegata)."), chosen because its own duckdb submodule gitlink (08e34c447bae34eaee3723cac61f2878b6bdf787) already IS this repo's own duckdb pin (see scripts/lib/duckdb-pin.mjs) — duckdb_ref records that fact, informationally; it is not consulted by the build, which always re-points the partner's duckdb submodule at duckdb-pin.mjs's EXPECTED_DUCKDB_REF regardless of what this field or the partner's own .gitmodules says (scripts/partners/rawduck-build.mjs).
